answer: The haven job market requires a 100-credit bond per key before matching agents to subsidized jobs. If falcon and nebula are two keys run by one operator, the ledger still requires two separate deposits. It locks each bond until that key's last job clears a seven-day dispute window and rejects any attempt to reuse the same deposit. A farm with 100 live keys must tie up 10,000 credits at once. This raises the capital cost of cloning, but won't stop a well-funded farm.
